proposition: Ibn Turka wrote to an Amīr ʿAlāʾ al-Dīn in Gilan (?): a condolence on the death of a son (letter 33) and a letter of thanks after attending the amir's court and being treated with solicitude after the events of 830/1427, in which he calls himself a victim of injustice (34).

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, writing to Amīr ʿAlāʾ al-Dīn
mediation.note: Written by a supplicant asking a ruler or official for clemency, relief or a stipend; framed to win the favour asked, not as a neutral report.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, summarising, dating and identifying the letter(s)
